clips.title: The story
paras: Snowbound ridges cut across the Tundrid Hills in south-central Dun Morogh, west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry. Dangerous wildlife keeps travelers to the rocky passes at their peril.

The Tundrid Hills offer a rough route from Coldridge Valley to eastern Dun Morogh, away from the main roads through Kharanos. Jagged, snowy slopes make the crossing dangerous. Ferocious predators prowl the hills, so travelers who leave the beaten path face peril without a drawn weapon.
